name: Bremelanotide
description: A melanocortin receptor agonist approved as Vyleesi for acquired generalised hypoactive sexual desire disorder in premenopausal women. Use in men is off-label.

systems.note: Central melanocortin-4 receptor agonism is the labelled mechanism; placed on the brain by intended effect rather than on the gonads.
Transient blood pressure rise and heart rate reduction are labelled.
